anchors.paper_title: Song recognition without identification: When people cannot "name that tune" but can recognize it as familiar.
anchors.reason: The paper describes a general finding about song recognition (RWI effect) and is cited by the dataset, but it does not introduce or describe the specific 'Song Familiarity' dataset itself.

metadata.methods_description: Participants listened to song melodies and responded when songs felt familiar. After familiarity judgment, participants attempted verbal identification of songs (title, artist, or lyrics). Participants then selected from a four-option multiple-choice display with visual feedback (correct: green highlight with checkmark; incorrect: red highlight with x). EEG recordings were synchronized with audio reconstructions of the experimental stimuli.
